notice: Illustrative subset of three NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control references. Not a baseline, not a tailoring decision, and passing a check does not mean a control is satisfied.

obligations.local_obligation: The reviewed policy bundle for the API allows exactly the role/action/resource combinations declared in the model and denies the independently authored negative cases.
obligations.limits: Does not show that the policy is deployed, that every API route calls it, or that access enforcement is complete.
obligations.rationale: The API is the only component the model shows mediating telemetry writes.

obligations.local_obligation: Synthetic audit records captured from the API include actor, action, target, time and outcome for every event type the model declares for the API.
obligations.limits: Does not show production log completeness, retention, or protection of audit records.
obligations.rationale: The model declares audit event types on the API component.

obligations.local_obligation: Each flow whose endpoints sit in different boundaries has (a) a design transport assertion and (b) a current, applicable transport test observation reporting pass.
obligations.limits: A model attribute alone cannot establish transport protection. A synthetic test report is not an observation of a real system.
obligations.rationale: Scope rule rather than a list, so new boundary-crossing flows enlarge the review scope automatically.

obligations.local_obligation: A claimed inherited SC-8 implementation is supported by provider/scope evidence that names the provider and the covered component.
obligations.limits: A provider statement is an assertion. Inheritance must not become satisfied because a vendor says so.
obligations.rationale: The model records an inheritance claim on the telemetry database.
